main_text.p:
Sic esto: & postquam irati mortalibus iras
Sic iusta numinis iubet
Qui sancti in terris nuper vixistis amici,
Caelo perennes viuite.
A tergo vobis donec sic Beza relictus,
Vos subsequutus assequar.

page.notes: The verse is set in a italic/script face with long s rendered as f in places; transcribed here with plain s. Printed words possibly misread: "iras" (line 1) and "viuite" (line 4) are read from a slightly blurred impression. The lower part of the page shows show-through from the reverse side and is not transcribed.
